Interception covers the editor\'s own network requests and requests made by user projects through http and okhttp. Image loading and WebView requests are not intercepted. Packaged APKs do not contain the interception logic, so they are not intercepted.
Direct connection, no proxy in use
When off, connections stay direct even if an address is set
One per line; a match means direct. Supports example.com (and subdomains) and *.example.com (subdomains only). Loopback addresses always go direct
One per line. Empty means every site not in the bypass list uses the proxy; if filled, only listed sites do

Applied via a process-wide ProxySelector, covering every request in the editor that uses the JVM network stack (Maven downloads, OkHttp, HttpURLConnection and clients built by third-party libraries). Accepts host:port, http://host:port and socks5://host:port. Loopback addresses such as 127.0.0.1 always go direct; WebView and the Lua socket module use native stacks and are unaffected; packaged APKs always connect directly.
Blocks writing, deleting or modifying other project directories; reading is unaffected
Blocks projects from deleting or moving the LuaForge-Studio work directory
Only applies while running a project inside the editor (projects must enable debug mode in their settings). Packaged APKs do not contain the firewall logic.
